UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile, app preferences, and marathon target configurations

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

displayName.description: User display name or hero alias

doomsdayMode.description: Flag indicating if Doomsday Essentials filter mode is active

spoilerUnlocked.description: Flag indicating if post-credit and story spoilers are unlocked

plannerHoursPerWeek.description: Weekly dedicated watch hours in the marathon planner

plannerTargetDate.description: ISO date string for marathon target completion

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of user profile creation

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update

WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: User watch progress, rating, favorites, and personal notes for a specific Marvel title

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this watchlist entry

titleId.description: Unique identifier of the Marvel title (e.g. loki-s1)

watched.description: Whether the user has completed watching this title

watchStatus.description: Current watch status of the title

watchedAt.description: ISO timestamp string when user marked title as watched

watchedPostCredit.description: Whether user watched/read the post-credit sequence

userRating.description: User rating on a scale of 1 to 10

isFavorite.description: Whether this title is pinned to user favorites

notes.description: User personal notes, theory, or review

progressMinutes.description: Watched progress in minutes for movies/series

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user configuration, preferences, and marathon timeline settings

/users/{userId}/watchlist/{titleId}.description: Stores individual title watch progress, rating, and notes per user
